topic: Field Items panel and stable hover info
currentUserGoal: Store and automation items should be repeat-buyable, displayed in a Field Items panel with counts, and expose mouseover output stats. Items should act visually/passively without a placement workflow; the sprinkler should pop up around the field instead of being placed.
changesMade: Added a Field Items panel that lists the Tiny Sprinkler, owned automation routes, and owned gold-store items with counts/status lines.
Changed gold-store consumables and companions to buy into the Field Items panel rather than being auto-used or placed.
Removed the active placement workflow from normal play; legacy placed views are cleared and helper actions fall back to whole-field behavior.
Changed the sprinkler to target field patches globally and show a brief pop-up sprinkler sprite during bursts.
Added field-item hover info with owned counts, route output, all automation per minute, lifetime auto touches, actions, supplies, and companion totals.
Fixed the Field Items hover flash by letting field-item hover detection own the shared info panel before board hover cleanup runs.
verification: Browser smoke at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&tiles=160: hovered Tiny Sprinkler and Sprinkler Route rows; the info panel stayed visible and updated with output stats.
currentGitStatus: Untracked docs include docs/FIRST_SESSION_AUDIT_2026-07-04.md and docs/POLISH_AND_SYSTEMS_ROADMAP.md, plus older local docs/assets already present.
knownIssues: The user is still playtesting the panel in their normal save; watch for tooltip placement/content tweaks.
The panel currently shows a limited number of rows with a '+N more' line; no scrolling or paging has been added yet.
The full perf harness at ?perfHarness&tiles=1200 was not run for this UI pass; only build plus a stress-route hover smoke check were run.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user verify mouseover in their live save, especially moving directly between Field Items rows.
Consider overflow paging or scrolling if the item list gets too crowded.
Run the perf harness before committing if additional field-item animations or denser panel updates are added.
doNotRevert: Do not restore item placement as the default interaction; the user explicitly wants items to be panel-owned and non-placeable.
Do not revert the sprinkler to a placed object; it should randomly pop up around the field.
Do not remove the untracked roadmap/audit docs without user approval; they were part of the current planning work.
